fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Jooble REST API key issued after the request form on https://jooble.org/api/about; it is the last path segment of every call (POST https://jooble.org/api/{api_Key}). Each Jooble country domain has its own key; the free plan is limited to 500 requests per key in total.

search.note: POST https://jooble.org/api/{api_Key} with a JSON body: keywords, location (both documented as required by Jooble, so pass a location), page (from 1) and ResultOnPage (items per page; no documented maximum, capped here at 100). Optional documented body fields radius (0|4|8|16|26|40|80 km), salary, SearchMode and companysearch are not sent. Response: totalCount plus jobs[] {id, title, location, snippet, salary (a formatted string such as '{min} - {max} {currency}', kept in raw), source, type, link, company, updated}. Aggregator: link opens the source board. Free plan: 500 requests per key, lifetime.

not_offered.me: No account endpoint: the REST API documents a single search call whose key travels in the URL path.
not_offered.get_posting: The REST API documents only the search call; there is no per-id endpoint — the search hit's link opens the posting on the source board.
not_offered.apply: Aggregator: 'apply goes to the origin board'; no application API is documented.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the documentation covers the search call only.
